sloka: शुष्कैर्वम्शैः समास्तीर्णमुLईरैश्च समावृतम् ।ततो वेतसशाखाश्च जम्बूशाखाश्च वीर्यवान् ॥२-५५-१५॥
transliteration: śuṣkairvamśaiḥ samāstīrṇamuLīraiśca samāvṛtam ।tato vetasaśākhāśca jambūśākhāśca vīryavān ॥2-55-15॥

translations.english: The valiant Lakshmana cut the stems of reeds and branches of the Jambu tree to prepare a comfortable seat for Sita (on that float).
